description: A display: it reads a pitch and a gate and names what is being played, as a note, an interval or a chord, on a dot-matrix readout, and marks the notes on a circle of fifths. It has no outputs.

inputs.text: The notes to be named, at 1V per octave, one per polyphonic channel
Marks which of those notes are sounding: a channel counts while its gate is above 4.99V

notes: the readout stays on Need PITCH... or Need GATE... until both jacks are patched. A pitch on its own names nothing.
the number of notes read is the smaller of the two channel counts, so a sixteen-channel pitch cable with a four-channel gate cable gives four notes.
with nothing playing the readout shows Monophonic or the voice count of the cables patched.
menu: Notation: English (C...A B), Latina (Do...La Si) — chooses whether note names are printed as letters or as Do, Re, Mi
